name: Blessed Arm
label: Quest
description: Having salvaged lightforge ingots from the wreck of the Flying Osprey in the Wetlands, an adventurer is directed to carry the precious metal to Stormwind…
intro: Having salvaged lightforge ingots from the wreck of the Flying Osprey in the Wetlands, an adventurer is directed to carry the precious metal to Stormwind City. There, the master dwarven smith Grimand Elmore awaits to fashion the raw metal into a tool capable of confronting the necromancer Morbent Fel.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is a dwarven weaponsmith in the Dwarven District of Stormwind who can craft with lightforge iron. His name is Grimand Elmore.

I've packed the iron you found into a crate. Take it to Grimand and tell him your tale. I'm sure he'll oblige someone on a quest such as yours, and craft for you a weapon - a weapon to give even Morbent Fel worry!

clips.title: Progress
paras: How might I ply my craft for you, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: That is quite a tale you have. And lightforge iron! Not for years have I worked with such a metal. It will be an honor to craft with it again. And you must return to me later with the story of your battle against the Necromancer.
But we get ahead of ourselves. First, your weapon against Morbent Fel...
